item.text:
This module calculates order totals, applies discount codes, computes an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the last iteration accesses `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, causing a `TypeError`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the line-item total (`price × qty`) by number of item rows, so it returns an average line subtotal—not the average unit-item price suggested by its name.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` (`0 / 0`); it needs an explicit empty-list behavior.
- Consequently, `formatOrder` also crashes for any order because it calls the broken `calcTotal`.
